question: Should Claw apply support inline MCP server configuration writes now, and what acknowledgement must guard that persistent mutation?
rationale: A Claw manifest can introduce commands, URLs, headers, environment values, and credentials into persistent configuration, so implementation correctness alone cannot establish the intended product trust boundary.

options.title: Expand existing apply acknowledgement
options.body: Name persistent MCP server configuration in the current human and JSON acknowledgement, with focused tests and live proof.

options.title: Require a separate MCP acknowledgement
options.body: Gate inline MCP artifacts behind a dedicated stronger confirmation before writing configuration.

options.title: Keep MCP artifacts preview-only
options.body: Defer mutation support until the broader Claws direction and prerequisite stack explicitly settle MCP ownership.

recommendation.title: Expand existing apply acknowledgement
recommendation.body: Name persistent MCP server configuration in the current human and JSON acknowledgement, with focused tests and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The MCP operator workflow and its configuration surface most consistently trace to this feature owner.
